urlText: Pyrmont bus diversions for Sydney Streets event
content:
Saturday 8 March
  • From 8am until 11.30pm, route 501 services will divert and miss stops while road closures are in place for the City of Sydney’s Sydney Streets event along Harris Street in Pyrmont.
  • Services towards Central will be diverting around Miller Street and Harris Street via Allen Street and services away from Central will be diverting around Harris Street and Miller Street via Pyrmont Bridge Road.
  • Stops will be missed on Harris Street and Miller Street between Allen Street and Bank Street in both directions, use alternative stops further along Harris Street.
  • Check signs at bus stops for alternative stop locations
Stops missed:
  • Miller Street before Harris Street, Pyrmont (200932)
  • Harris Street at Pyrmont Bridge Road, Pyrmont (200916)
  • Harris Street at Allen Street, Pyrmont (200933)
  • Harris Street after Pyrmont Bridge Road, Pyrmont (200928)
  • Fish Market Light Rail, Miller Street, Pyrmont (200929)
Alternative Stops:
  • Harris Street after Fig Street, Ultimo (200726)
  • Harris Street after Allen Street, Pyrmont (200926)
subtitle: Pyrmont bus diversions for Sydney Streets event

urlText: Bathurst Bullet temporary timetable changes on Wednesdays
content:
Wednesdays until 26 March 2025, some Bathurst train times will change.
 
Temporary timetable changes will apply to the following trains:
  • 06:00 Lithgow to Bathurst service will now depart Lithgow 24 minutes earlier at 05:36 and depart earlier at all stations including Rydal 05:55 and Tarana 06:11, arriving Bathurst at 06:44.
  • 07:40 Bathurst to Central service will continue to depart Bathurst at 07:40 but will arrive Central earlier at 11:20 instead of 11:52.
  • 15:52 Central to Bathurst service will now depart Central 52 minutes earlier at 15:00 and depart earlier at all stations including Parramatta 15:22, Penrith 15:46, Springwood 16:08, Katoomba 16:42, Mount
  • Victoria 16:58, Lithgow 17:24, Rydal 17:41 and Tarana 18:14, arriving Bathurst at 18:47. 
    20:25 Bathurst to Lithgow service will now depart Bathurst 63 minutes earlier at 19:22, Tarana 19:54 and Rydal 20:10, arriving Lithgow at 20:29.

  • During trackwork these times may change. Plan your trip before you travel for up-to-date real time information. You can also subscribe to planned trackwork alerts.
subtitle: Bathurst Bullet temporary timetable changes on Wednesdays

urlText: Route 600 is changing from 3 March
content:
From Monday 3 March, route 600 services will operate between Pennant Hills and Parramatta only. New route 590 will operate between Hornsby and Pennant Hills.
Passengers travelling from Parramatta to Hornsby can transfer at Pennant Hills for route 590 towards Hornsby or for train services.
Timetable changes will also affect some bus routes across North West Sydney.
 
Plan your trip for real time up-to-date information.

urlText: Sydney CBD, Bridge St diversions due St Patrick’s Day Parade
content:
Route 263 will be starting and ending trips at Wynyard instead of Bridge St from 10.30am to 12pm midday due to road closures in place for the St Patrick’s Day Parade.
 
Buses to the city will end trips at Wynyard Station, York St, Stand N (200036). Buses leaving the city will start trips from Wynyard Station, York Street, Stand L (200034).
 
Check signs at stops and allow extra travel time.
 
Missed stops:
  • Burns Philp Building, Bridge Street (2000417)
  • Bridge St at Gresham St (200096)

urlText: Lakemba Station bus stop changes for Lakemba Nights Festival
content:
Thursday 27 February to Sunday 30 March
  • Each week, from Thursday to Sunday between 4pm and 4.30am, Southwest Link bus services will be temporarily relocated for the Lakemba Nights Festival.
Affected stops:
  • Lakemba Station, The Boulevard, Stand E (219527)
    - Alternative bus stop is Haldon Street, Stand B (219514) for the following services:
    • SW1 – Bankstown
    • SW2 – Bankstown
    • N40 – East Hills

  • Lakemba Station, The Boulevarde, Stand D (2195118)
    - Alternative bus stop is Haldon Street, Stand A (219515) for the following services:
    • SW1 – Sydenham
    • SW2 – Sydenham
    • N40 – Town Hall

urlText: L4 Westmead and Carlingford Line weeknight full closures due to maintenance
content:
From Monday 10 to Wednesday 12 March, nightly from 9pm to 1am, L4 Westmead and Carlingford Line light rail services will be impacted by closures due to planned trackwork and maintenance works.
 
During this time, use alternative transport including L4 replacement bus services, regular bus services or walking if able to between Westmead and Carlingford.
 
L4 replacement bus services:
  • Nightly from 9pm to 1am, replacement bus services will run between Westmead and Carlingford. There are two bus replacement services routes options:

    Westmead to Carlingford bus replacement route
    On this route, replacement buses will not stop at the following locations:
    • Westmead Hospital – Please use the alternative stop at Westmead or Children’s Hospital (approx. 9 minute walk and 4 minute walk)
    • Ngara
    • Benaud Oval
    • Fennell Street
    • Prince Alfred Square
    • Church Street
    • Rosehill Gardens – Please use the alternative stop at Tramway Avenue (approx. 8 minute walk)

      Use Parramatta Square to North Parramatta loop replacement bus services for stops between Parramatta Square and Ngara.

  • Parramatta Square to North Parramatta bus replacement loop
    This route will only serve the following stops: Ngara, Benaud Oval, Fennell Street, Prince Alfred Square, Church Street, and Parramatta Square.
See the news story for more detailed service information.
Allow extra travel time and use the Trip Planner to see if your travel is affected.

urlText: Changes to school bus services and pass requirements in North Rothbury and Maitland area
content:
From Friday 31 January, a new morning and afternoon school bus service will run between North Rothbury and Rutherford Technology High School to meet student demand following community feedback. 
  • School route S526: A new service in the morning, operated by Grace Coaches will service North Rothbury, Branxton, Greta and Lochinvar before arriving at Rutherford Technology High School.
  • School route S526: A new afternoon service, operated by Grace Coaches will depart Rutherford Technology High School and service Greta, Branxton and North Rothbury.
Changes to other services:
  • Maitland Grossman High School and Maitland High School students who previously took the Grace Coaches S520 morning service should now take CDC school route 2571 and transfer to the regular route 180 service at Rutherford Shopping Centre (Hillview Street). In the afternoon, students can utilise the 2194 CDC school service.
  • Students from Maitland Public School, St John the Baptist Primary School and All Saints College who took the Grace Coaches S520 service to and from school will now catch the CDC school route 2712 morning service and the 2194 afternoon service.  
  • The S520 school route has been redesigned to service Rutherford and Aberglasslyn. 
Important:
  • Departure and arrival times and routes of some services have changed. Please check Trip Planner for details.
  • The school bus you travel on may be a CDC bus (operated by Hunter Valley Buses) or a Grace Coaches bus. If it is a CDC bus, you will need an Opal card. If it is a Grace Coaches bus, you will need a school travel pass. If your service has changed, find out more about how to apply for a pass. 
To view the adjusted routes and plan your trip, visit Trip Planner.
subtitle: Changes to school bus services and pass requirements in North Rothbury and Maitland area

Visit transportnsw.info and Trip Planner for more information and to view the adjusted routes.

urlText: North Coast service disruptions due to Cyclone Alfred.
content: NSW TrainLink North coast services departing Sydney will terminate at Taree and are replaced by coach for the remainder of the journey. Coaches north of Taree are not guaranteed and will only run as far as Casino if safe to do so. Services returning to Sydney will commence as a train service from Taree and are replaced by coach from Casino to Taree if it is safe to do so.

urlText: L1 services expected to be busy due to ICC Sydney events
content:
On Wednesday 12 and Thursday 13 March: 
  • L1 light rail services will be busy as attendees travel to and from ICC Sydney Theatre for the NSW Premier’s Gala Concerts. 
  • Allow plenty of extra travel time and follow directional signs and staff announcements. 
For event attendees: 
  • L1 Dulwich Hill Line services will run at an increased frequency of 6 minutes from 7am to 7pm daily. 
  • Upon staff direction, events buses will supplement light rail services between Central Station and Exhibition Centre during busy periods each day.
  • Walking might be an alternative option (20-minute walk between Central and ICC Sydney Theatre). 
For more information, visit the NSW Premier’s Gala Concerts event page.
